structure_proposals.why: Your new gym has no smith machine and your exercise list has no incline press at all, so tonight's opener becomes assisted dips at 4 sets of 8 to 12 — the only chest compound left in the list that needs no smith machine and no new load history, since it is bodyweight; answer No if the new gym has no dip station either and I will find you something else.

On 2 September you pressed dumbbells at 45 and 50 into a slot still named for a smith machine the new gym does not have, so this renames it to the dumbbell shoulder press you are actually doing — 4 sets of 8 to 10 instead of the smith bar's 6 to 8.

Pull B still opens with a smith row the new gym does not have and your list has no barbell row to rename it to, so it becomes the wide seated cable row at 4 sets of 8 to 10 — heavier and lower-rep than the same row on Pull A.

You already ran this slot with a barbell on 5 September and wrote so on the card, but it is still named Smith RDL and your list has no RDL, so it becomes the deadlift at 4 sets of 8 to 10 — same four sets you did, lighter and higher-rep than your Pull A sets of 5 to 6.

Push A is eight lifts long and on 27 August it stopped part-way through the sixth, so the rope pushdown — your second triceps isolation of the night, sitting dead last behind three sets of overhead extensions — got none of its sets at all, and on 17 August, the one Push A you did finish, it went backwards inside the set: 52.5 for fifteen, then 47.5 for thirteen, then 47.5 for eleven.

Open question for you, not a change: you asked on 17 August why there are no corrective exercises in the program, and the accurate answer is that there are three — face pulls here on Pull A and again on Pull B, and the hip adductor and abductor on both leg days — but they are all either below the waist or a rowing-plane pull, and there is no shoulder-rotation or anti-rotation movement anywhere in the app's exercise list for me to put on a card, so this slot stays exactly as it is until that list itself is changed, which is a change to the app and needs your word rather than mine.
